text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data without being directly programmed. One common approach is supervised learning, where a computer learns from labelled examples. During this process, the system is given training data, which includes both the input and the correct answer. The computer uses this data to build models, which are like rules it can follow. Once a model is ready, it can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy — the higher the accuracy, the better the model has learned.
